mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.2 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts higher future consumption and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals deteriorating business conditions and lower corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based demand expansion that supports corporate revenue growth and earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20d SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate indicates persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, which increases wage growth and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.3% and PAYEMS > 146000.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior four quarters, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 245.0), signals a healthy, inflation-controlled expansion that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 17000.0 and CPIAUCSL < 245.0, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
